description: Get a day/week/month breakdown of sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, complained, replied, and unsubscribed — across every send medium (campaigns, inbox compose, API, MCP, SDKs, GraphQL, automations). The timeline counterpart to get_analytics's period totals.

group_by.description: Time bucket for each row (default day)

period.description: Shorthand window used when start_date is omitted (default 30d)

name: get_analytics_timeline
